Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an incorrect assumption by stating that the cell wall is common to both plant and animal cells. While the extracellular matrix/glycocalyx in animals serves some functions analogous to a cell wall, it is not structurally equivalent to a cell wall, which is exclusive to plant cells. This misunderstanding led to the erroneous conclusion that the correct answer was C) nucleus, cell wall, cell membrane, instead of B) cell membrane, nucleus, mitochondrion. The Planner also incorrectly claimed that mitochondria are not universal to animal cells, which is a misinterpretation, as mitochondria are indeed present in all animal cells except specific exceptions like mature red blood cells.
